# Антон Агальцов - IT Management & Leadership

> A comprehensive resource on IT management, team leadership, and professional development by Anton Agaltsov, covering practical guides, case studies, and insights for IT leaders.

The site serves IT managers, team leads, and specialists seeking to improve their leadership capabilities and organizational effectiveness. It combines personal expertise with curated knowledge on team management, distributed structures, incident analysis, and workplace culture.

## Key Topics

- IT Management
- Team Leadership
- Team Management
- Project Management
- Agile Methodology
- Professional Development
- Workplace Culture
- Distributed Teams
- Incident Analysis
- Self-Development
- Case Studies
- Leadership Development
- Software Development
- IT Architecture

## Core Resources

- [Личная страница](https://agaltsovav.ru): Anton Agaltsov's personal website on IT management and leadership
- [Обо мне](https://agaltsovav.ru/about): Bio of Anton Agaltsov with IT career and technical experience
- [Менторство и консультация](https://agaltsovav.ru/mentoring): Mentoring and consulting services on IT architecture and management

## Team Leadership & Management

- [Как разговаривать с командой о проблемах конструктивно](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/how-to-talk-to-your-team-about-problems-so-that-it-is-perceived-constructively): Guide on constructive feedback and problem discussion with teams
- [Как наладить эффективную коммуникацию при распределённой структуре](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/how-to-establish-effective-communication-in-a-distributed-structure): Guide to effective communication in distributed teams with tools
- [5 элементов идеальной рабочей атмосферы](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/5-elements-of-the-ideal-working-environment): 5 key elements TeamLead can implement for ideal work environment
- [«У вас» или «у нас»](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/yours-or-ours): Article on new employee integration and company culture markers
- [Почему мне так плохо, хотя вроде бы всё нормально](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/why-do-i-feel-so-crappy-even-though-everything-seems-fine): Article on emotional discomfort and internal dissatisfaction causes

## Knowledge Base & Documentation

- [База знаний](https://agaltsovav.ru/docs): Knowledge base on IT management for leaders and specialists
- [Методы для анализа инцидентов](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/methods-for-incident-analysis): Guide on incident analysis methods including RCA and ICAM
- [Кейсы для руководителя](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/cases-for-managers): Case studies section for IT managers and leadership development

## Case Studies & Decision Making

- [Кейсы](https://agaltsovav.ru/cases): Case studies for IT leadership self-assessment and team management
- [Выбор Софи](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/sophies-choice): Metaphor on difficult management decisions and ethical dilemmas

- [Блог](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog): Blog covering IT management, team leadership, and professional development
- [«Agile умер!»: основные аргументы и откуда они берутся](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/agile-is-dead-the-main-arguments-and-where-they-come-from): Analysis of Agile methodology criticism and decline arguments
- [Итоги конференции «Стачка 2024»: Впечатления и ключевые моменты](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/stachk%D0%B0-spb-2024): Review of Stachka 2024 conference and TeamLead section insights

- [Почему настольные игры на работе — скрытый кошмар](https://agaltsovav.ru/blog/why-board-games-at-work-are-a-hidden-nightmare): Analysis of workplace board games' short and long-term consequences
